request: Make diagnostic reporting a required transitive library even for consumers who disable all default features, so dependency graphs stay identical across our products.

source.request: Make diagnostic reporting a required transitive library even for consumers who disable all default features, so dependency graphs stay identical across our products.
source.settled: The log dependency is optional but enabled by default, allowing consumers to build globset without it.
source.why: Making the reporting library mandatory removes the dependency opt-out that the ticket introduced.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
